## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run format:check` pass
- [ ] `npm test` passes (backend and frontend as applicable)
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Schema changes ship as a migration — no `synchronize`, no manual SQL
- [ ] New env vars are added to `env.validation.ts`, `.env.example`, and the README table
- [ ] New endpoints declare `@Roles` / `@RequirePermissions`, or `@Public()` on purpose
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or password hashes in responses, logs, or fixtures
